title: SpaceMosaic
waiting: Waiting for picker or provider metadata…
unavailable: Provider or picker unavailable. Choose the folder again.
denied: Access denied or revoked. Choose the folder again.
session: Access for this session; persistence not confirmed
truncated: Preview limited to 32 entries; this is a partial listing.
metadata_only: Only metadata is inspected. No file contents are downloaded. No volume capacity is measured.
incomplete_directory: Directory not fully scanned. Its complete size is unknown.
scan_node_limit: Scan stopped: object limit reached. Some folders were not scanned.
scan_memory_limit: Scan stopped: metadata memory limit reached. Some folders were not scanned.
scan_cancelled: Scan cancelled. The result covers only the objects already read.
scan_incomplete: Some folders or metadata could not be read or were skipped.
preferences_save_failed: Settings could not be saved. Check access to the settings directory.
mount_policy: Applied to the next scan. Links are never followed.
export_failed: Could not save the export. Check the destination permissions.
size_caveat: Selected scope only. Known file sizes are not guaranteed reclaimable space. Unknown sizes remain unknown.
name: Name
map_help: Select an item to inspect it. Double-click a folder to zoom in. Smaller items open as a list.
no_map: Zero and unknown sizes are available in the list.
open_failed: Could not open the system file manager.
hard_link_note: Hard-linked file: each path is counted. Shared blocks are not deduplicated.
empty_body: Choose a folder or drop it here. Explore its contents without changing your files.
privacy_note: Local by design. No accounts, uploads, or file contents required.
mobile_scope: Only the selected provider tree is scanned. Missing metadata remains unknown; cloud file contents are not downloaded.
access_revoked: Provider or picker unavailable. Choose the folder again.
provider_unavailable: Provider or picker unavailable. Choose the folder again.
picker_busy: Provider or picker unavailable. Choose the folder again.
provider_busy: Provider or picker unavailable. Choose the folder again.
window_unavailable: Provider or picker unavailable. Choose the folder again.
picker_unavailable: Provider or picker unavailable. Choose the folder again.
provider_cycle: Skipped a repeated provider directory to prevent a cycle.
phone_intro_body: Choose a folder to compare its files and subfolders. Nothing is deleted.
phone_map_hint: Tap an item to inspect it. Open a folder from its details.
phone_scan_body: You can leave this screen open while the folder is being measured.
allocated_unavailable: Allocated space is not provided by this storage provider. File sizes are shown instead.
empty_saved_hint: Or open a result you saved earlier to review it or compare it with a new scan.
import_failed: This file could not be opened as a SpaceMosaic result.
import_error_io: The file could not be read. Check that it still exists and that you may open it.
import_error_too_large: The file is larger than this device can safely load.
import_error_version: This result was saved by a newer version of SpaceMosaic. Update the app to open it.
import_error_malformed: The file is damaged or is not a SpaceMosaic JSON result.
import_error_invalid: The file contradicts itself, so it was not opened. It may be damaged or edited.
saved_snapshot_note: A snapshot of an earlier scan. The folder is not being read; sizes may be out of date. Paths in this file are never opened.
saved_schema_one: Older format (schema 1): the scanned area and per-folder listing state were not recorded, so comparisons are more cautious.
compare_needs_scan: To compare, scan a folder first using the normal folder choice.
compare_needs_both: Comparison needs a saved result and a current scan.
compare_direction_help: Changes are measured from the baseline (before) to the current result (after). Use Swap if the order is wrong.
cmp_verdict_insufficient: Not enough is recorded to confirm that both results describe the same area.
cmp_verdict_incompatible: These results describe different areas and are not compared.
compare_confirm_scope: I confirm both results describe the same area. This is my statement; it is not technically verified.
cmp_needs_confirmation: Confirm that both results describe the same area first.
cmp_net_complete: All compared objects were fully measured.
cmp_net_partial: Only confirmed items. Not a total.
cmp_lower_bound: Amount is a minimum (part of the size is unknown) for:
cmp_disclaimer: Compares recorded sizes only. A size change does not prove deletion or freed disk space, and equal sizes do not prove unchanged contents.
cmp_none_native: No comparison yet. Start one from the main screen.
cmp_reason_size_unknown: A size is unknown in one or both results, so the change cannot be calculated.
cmp_reason_overflow: A size exceeds the numeric range, so the change cannot be calculated.
cmp_reason_baseline_not_observed: The baseline did not list this folder completely, so this cannot be called new.
cmp_reason_current_not_observed: The current scan did not list this folder completely, so this cannot be called missing or freed.
cmp_reason_ambiguous: Several objects share this name in one result; they are not paired.
cmp_reason_listing_incomplete: This folder was not fully listed in one of the results.
cmp_reason_partial: Part of this folder cannot be compared.
cmp_scope_no_identity: An older export does not record the scanned area's identity.
cmp_scope_different_source: The results come from different kinds of storage access.
cmp_scope_different_platform: The results were made on different platforms.
cmp_scope_different_authority: The results come from different storage providers.
cmp_scope_provider_spelling: The root locators differ; their spelling may vary between sessions.
cmp_scope_object_changed: The root folder looks like a different object (its identity changed).
cmp_scope_volume_unverified: The volume or device is not recorded, so a replaced volume under the same path cannot be excluded.
cmp_limit_baseline_partial: The baseline is partial (cancelled, limited or with unread folders).
cmp_limit_current_partial: The current scan is partial (cancelled, limited or with unread folders).
cmp_limit_crossing: The scans used different filesystem-boundary settings.
cmp_limit_allocated: Allocated space was not measured in both results; only logical sizes are compared.
cmp_limit_older_schema: At least one result uses the older format; its folder listing state is inferred cautiously.
cmp_limit_user_confirmed: Same-area correspondence was confirmed by you, not by recorded data.
